product_risk_or_requirement: Realistic AI-dubbed audio can reach viewers without the platform's required synthetic-media disclosure label, matching the exact undisclosed-impersonation pattern documented in SRC-01 and now enforced as a compliance failure under SRC-04 and SRC-06.
current_state: An automated policy-classification check runs before publish, but its detection accuracy specifically for in-product AI-dubbed audio has not yet been evaluated against a labeled test set.
product_requirement: Every video produced with the in-product voice-dubbing feature must be treated as realistic-synthetic-audio by default, auto-labeled per platform disclosure policy, and blocked from publishing without either the label or a logged human policy-reviewer override.
acceptance_criteria: Given a video was produced using the in-product AI voice-dubbing feature and is realistic enough that a viewer could mistake it for the creator's authentic voice, When the creator attempts to publish the video, Then the system must apply the platform's AI-generated-audio disclosure label and must not allow publish to complete without either an applied disclosure label or a human policy-reviewer override logged with reviewer identity and timestamp.
evidence_needed: Precision/recall audit report of the synthetic-audio disclosure classifier against a labeled test set, showing recall of at least 95% for realistic AI-dubbed audio.

product_risk_or_requirement: The voice-cloning vendor may retain or reuse a creator's submitted voice sample beyond the requested dub job without an enforceable no-reuse commitment, matching the reuse-beyond-stated-purpose pattern documented in SRC-02.
current_state: No signed data-processing addendum exists with the voice-cloning vendor restricting reuse of submitted voice samples, and no creator-facing deletion-request flow exists yet.
product_requirement: The voice-cloning vendor contract must include a data-processing addendum prohibiting reuse of submitted voice samples beyond the requested dub job, backed by an auditable deletion attestation, and creators must have a self-service way to request deletion of their submitted sample.
acceptance_criteria: Given a creator submits a voice sample to the voice-cloning vendor for dubbing, When the dub job completes, Then the vendor's contractual data-processing addendum requires sample deletion or non-reuse beyond that job, and the creator can view and trigger a deletion request from their account settings.
evidence_needed: Signed vendor data-processing addendum and the first quarterly deletion/no-reuse attestation from the vendor.

product_risk_or_requirement: Vietnam's Law on Artificial Intelligence (134/2025/QH15, effective 2026-03-01) addresses AI-generated content, but the available official summary does not detail the specific disclosure or labeling obligations that would apply to this product, leaving the legal status uncertain for the Vietnam market.
current_state: No formal legal review has been completed against Vietnam AI Law implementing provisions for this product's synthetic-audio dubbing and pre-publish compliance-check features.
product_requirement: Obtain a documented legal review confirming which Vietnam AI Law obligations (disclosure, registration, risk classification) apply to this product before it is offered to any creator in the Vietnam market, and update product behavior or labeling to match.
acceptance_criteria: Given the product is scoped to launch to creators in the Vietnam market, When the pilot launch review is scheduled, Then a documented legal opinion on applicable Vietnam AI Law obligations must be attached to the release record before a go or conditional-go decision is finalized for that market.
evidence_needed: Written legal opinion referencing Vietnam AI Law 134/2025/QH15 and any implementing decisions applicable to synthetic-media content tools.
